        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>query</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>list</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enoughGw</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>orderOne</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>orderSeveral</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ordersMerged</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>startBuild</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>build</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>stockGw</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reorderCheap</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reorderFast</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>mail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>finish</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endStopped</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="webshop" name="Web shop">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>deliver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Contract project starts" />
    <bpmn:task id="query" name="Query all web shops for quantity, price and delivery time" />
    <bpmn:task id="list" name="Create a list of parts to order from each shop" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="enoughGw" name="One shop has enough parts?" />
    <bpmn:task id="orderOne" name="Order the cheapest parts from one shop" />
    <bpmn:task id="orderSeveral" name="Order the cheapest parts from several shops" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ordersMerged" name="Orders placed" />
    <bpmn:task id="deliver" name="Deliver the parts in batches in random order" />
    <bpmn:task id="startBuild" name="Start building when the first parts arrive" />
    <bpmn:task id="build" name="Build the product" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="stockGw" name="Stock of a single part?" />
    <bpmn:task id="reorderCheap" name="Reorder the cheapest parts" />
    <bpmn:task id="reorderFast" name="Reorder the fastest parts" />
    <bpmn:task id="mail" name="Write a mail to friends complaining about the web shops" />
    <bpmn:task id="finish" name="Finish the contract" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endDone" name="Contract finished" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endStopped" name="Project stopped without parts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="query" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="query" targetRef="list" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="list" targetRef="enoughGw" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" name="Yes" sourceRef="enoughGw" targetRef="orderOne" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" name="No" sourceRef="enoughGw" targetRef="orderSeveral" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="orderOne" targetRef="ordersMerged" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="orderSeveral" targetRef="ordersMerged" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="ordersMerged" targetRef="deliver" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="deliver" targetRef="startBuild" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="startBuild" targetRef="build" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="build" targetRef="stockGw" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" name="5 or more" sourceRef="stockGw" targetRef="finish" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" name="3 or 4" sourceRef="stockGw" targetRef="reorderCheap" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" name="1 or 2" sourceRef="stockGw" targetRef="reorderFast" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" name="Zero" sourceRef="stockGw" targetRef="mail" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="reorderCheap" targetRef="build" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f17" sourceRef="reorderFast" targetRef="build" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f18" sourceRef="finish" targetRef="endDone" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f19" sourceRef="mail" targetRef="endStopped" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
